Mindfulness doesn't require a spare hour or a silent retreat — a handful of short practices can fit into even the busiest schedule.

## Micro-breaks between tasks

Taking sixty seconds to notice your breathing between meetings can reset your attention more effectively than pushing straight through the day.

## Mindful transitions

Turning a routine moment, like a commute or a coffee break, into a brief mindfulness practice avoids needing to carve out extra time at all.

## Keeping it simple

The goal isn't a perfect meditation practice — even a few conscious breaths, done consistently, produce more benefit than an elaborate routine abandoned after a week.

Building mindfulness into moments you already have, rather than adding a new block to an already full calendar, is what makes the habit stick long-term.
